topics.title: Introduction to computer system: CPU, input and output devices

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the role of the CPU, its registers, ALU and control unit.
Identify input and output devices and how data entered is stored.
Recall key inventions from the abacus to the tabulating machine.
Explain the stored program concept and Von Neumann architecture.
Relate LSI, VLSI, SLSI and Moore's Law to the growth of computing power.
Convert between bits, nibbles, bytes and larger memory units.
Distinguish RAM and ROM by volatility and use.
Explain the role of cache memory and compare secondary memory with primary memory.

topics.title: Data transfer between memory and CPU

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the data, address and control buses and their direction of transfer.
Describe how the CPU reads from and writes to main memory over the system bus.
Interpret the generations of microprocessors and their memory sizes.
Explain word size, clock speed and cores of a microprocessor.
Distinguish a microcontroller from a microprocessor and give its uses.
Classify data as structured, unstructured or semi-structured.
Describe data capturing, storage and retrieval.
Explain how deleted data can be recovered and how to protect it.

topics.title: Software: system software, programming tools and application software

concepts.learning_objective: Identify operating systems, system utilities and device drivers as system software.
Distinguish low-level and high-level languages and the role of assembler, compiler and interpreter.
Classify application software and distinguish FOSS, freeware and proprietary software.
Describe the objectives of an operating system and its types of user interface.
Explain process, memory, file and device management by the operating system.
